topic: Trail Bay Black Friday weekend: come see me (draw teaser)
text:
Shopping local this Black Friday on the Sunshine Coast?

Come find me at Trail Bay Centre in Sechelt:
Fri, Nov 27, 11–4
Sun, Nov 29

Try the RIMAN products on your own hands, and guess how many candies are in my tub to win a Multi Stick Balm or a facial.

See you there? 🎁
picture_tip: Your candy tub front and centre on the booth table, RIMAN products lined up behind it, a handwritten 'Guess & win!' card. Shot in daylight, square or 4:5.
video_tip: 8–10 s: slow push-in on the candy tub (2 s), pan to the Multi Stick Balm and a facial card (3 s), end on you waving behind the table (3 s). On-screen text: 'Trail Bay · Fri 27 + Sun 29'.

text:
Your shampoo doesn't belong on your ends.

Winter hair after 40, 3 fixes:
1. Warm water, not hot
2. Shampoo the scalp only; the rinse cleans the ends
3. 1–2 pumps of hair oil serum on mid-lengths and ends, not the scalp

I use botalab Deserticola Plus. Save this for wash day.
picture_tip: The three botalab Deserticola bottles (shampoo, conditioner, hair oil serum) on the edge of your tub with a folded towel. Simple, bright bathroom light.
video_tip: 10–12 s, no face needed: pump shampoo into your palm (2 s), fingers massaging at the roots (4 s), then 1–2 pumps of oil serum worked through the ends of dry hair (4 s). Text: 'Scalp, not ends.'

topic: Multi Stick Balm 'group chat' list (stocking stuffer)
text:
If winter dryness had a group chat, these would be the regulars:

Lips
Cheekbones
Knuckles

One stick in my purse handles all three: RIMAN's Multi Stick Balm.

Where does winter hit you first?
picture_tip: The Multi Stick Balm held up in your hand next to your coat pocket or purse, outdoors on a grey day for that winter feel.
video_tip: 6–8 s: three quick swipes, lips (2 s), cheekbone (2 s), knuckles (2 s), then cap it and drop it in your purse. Text: 'Lips. Cheeks. Knuckles.'
